answer: Mechanism: Saffron–Juniper Anchor Cadence. Each agent earns send eligibility only through an observed traffic shape: a slow juniper heartbeat (randomized 2–9 s gaps) punctuated by saffron anchor pulses at unpredictable epochs. The relay samples inter-arrival entropy, burst ratio, and cross-epoch continuity; identities lacking that shape stay throttled. Sybils must run many concurrent schedulers, hold connections open, and wait through real time to accumulate cadence—costing wall-clock latency, socket/scheduler capacity, and correlation risk.
